 Two Dynamo players called up to Ukraine national team for Nations League matches
 04.11.2026, 09:00 
 Print 
 Share: 
 Ukraine national team head coach Andrea Maldera has announced the list of players called up for the decisive UEFA Nations League matches in November.
 Two representatives of Dynamo Kyiv have been included in the squad – defender Taras Mykhavko and forward Matvii Ponomarenko .
 It should be noted that goalkeepers Ruslan Neshcheret and Georhii Bushchan , as well as midfielders Oleksandr Pikhalionok and Volodymyr Brazhko , have been included in the reserve list.
 As a reminder, during the upcoming international break, the Ukraine national team will play two matches in Group 2 of League B of the UEFA Nations League.
 Ukraine’s opponents will be Northern Ireland (November 14 at 21:45 Kyiv time) and Georgia (November 17 at 21:45).
